title: Affine-basis lower-tail section reconstruction
statement: For a scheme X, affine open V, integer-indexed complex F of O_X-modules, and lower cutoff a, let E = τ_{<a}QF. If every homology sheaf of F has vanishing positive module cohomology on every affine W contained in V, then the derived functor of evaluation on V followed by exact forgetting to abelian groups sends E to a derived inverse limit of its canonical bounded-below lower truncations. The Roos triangle is the one induced by the canonical truncation maps.

proof.text: Apply affineBasisRestrictedLowerTail_local_bound to obtain a basis on the open subscheme V with cohomological bound zero for exact restriction of the lower tail.

Choose the standard derived category for modules on V, apply truncation_isDerivedLimitTriangle_of_local_bound with d=0, and map the resulting specified Roos triangle using rightDerivedFunctor_isDerivedLimitTriangle for abelian global sections on V. Sections preserve products. The private map_product_lift lemma identifies its first map using each product projection.

Use openDerivedSections_truncationTower_comparison. The private transport_roos_triangle lemma forms the product of the component isomorphisms, checks the first and middle maps by product projections and the two compatibility squares, and transports the last map by the inverse product isomorphism and the shifted e. Transport the distinguished triangle with Triangle.isoMk.

theorem affineBasisLowerTail_sections_reconstruction
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
    (F : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hhomology : ∀ (W : X.Opens), IsAffineOpen W → W ≤ V → ∀ (n : ℤ) (q : ℕ),
      Subsingleton (((F.homology n).restrict W.ι).H (q + 1)))
    (a : ℤ) :
    let S := SheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (op V)
    letI : S.Additive := inferInstanceAs
      ((SheafOfModules.forget.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.evaluation.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj (op V)).Additive)
    let G := S ⋙ forget₂
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op V))) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
    let t := DerivedCategory.TStructure.t
      (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let E := (t.truncLT a).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj F)
    ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ => G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((t.truncGE (-(n : ℤ))).obj E))) ⟶ (G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj E)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      IsDerivedLimitTriangle (fun n : ℕ => G.rightDerivedFunctor.map
        ((t.natTransTruncGEOfLE (-((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)) (-(n : ℤ)) (by omega)).app E))
        (G.rightDerivedFunctor.obj E)
        (Pi.lift (fun n : ℕ => G.rightDerivedFunctor.map
          ((t.truncGEπ (-(n : ℤ))).app E))) δ
